what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Colombia in Chile: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1514 Colombian asylum seekers in Chile, 0.5% of all asylum seekers from Colombia.
Refugees from Colombia, a separate group, live mostly in Ecuador, Venezuela, Canada and Costa Rica.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Colombia in every year from 1995 to 2025, with the ELN and FARC groups among the opponents.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2016 to 2024, fall within that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 18 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 5069, at the end of 2018, and was lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Chile.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Chile only.
